description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_ErrorStruct, which manages error information related to HTML document segments such as tokens, attributes, and CSS properties. It encapsulates error data, its association with specific document parts, and supports hierarchical structures of error details.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorStruct
classes.description: A class that records and manages errors for specific parts of an HTML document, supporting hierarchical error structures with child ErrorStructs.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a child ErrorStruct based on specified type and identifier, maintaining hierarchical error data.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error entry with severity and message to the current ErrorStruct.
